Are The Colts Still In Trouble With The Offensive Line?

The answer is 'yes'.

We made 1 o-line acquisition this year, and it was Todd Herremans. He appears to be a really great guy, but is also 32, and finished the last 2 seasons on IR. I hope he has a great year, but his lone arrival doesn't put my O-line worries to rest.

We have money for everything else, but not offensive line. It's like we spent $200 million building a race car, and then Irsay is like "sorry, we can't afford seat belts, because the engine needed an extra $20 million".

I feel like every time we trot Luck out there without really addressing the line, we're basically shaving years off the back end of his career. All these hits over all these years will add up, and if we don't start protecting Luck now, there won't be anything left to protect later.

I think it depends on the type of offense we run. Luck isn't going to get hit a ton from Castonzo's side so his blind side is protected. Getting Gore helps keep defense's honest but then with how many quality WR's we have, SOMEone is going to be open for the dump off if needed.

We are playing a little loose with Luck, but the dude is Ben Rothlisberger 2.0 in that he is insanely strong/big for a QB. The dude is the size of a TE. It'll take a really good hit to do some damage to him.
I agree with you, we're fortunate Luck is as sturdy as he is, but I'd still rather put my faith in a good offensive line.
